mechanism: Bisacodyl-induced diarrhea and bowel stimulation can increase fluid and electrolyte losses, potentially enhancing hypokalemia and dehydration caused by bumetanide's loop diuretic action.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) and fluid status closely; consider stool softeners instead of stimulant laxatives if constipation management is needed in patients on bumetanide.
